result: Prototype staging reviewed; no blocking party occlusion observed at the recorded positions.
scope: Static inspection of detached native WorldView at legal party positions, source-based campaign fixtures and the normal steady camera focus. Native update transforms and camera settle with intermediate drawing suspended; one real final render is restored for each image. No CSS/geometry/pose injection. This is not a public campaign traversal or a performance measurement.

views.label: feros-colony
views.note: Foreground blocks moved behind/peripheral to the contact square; the three party bodies and four contacts are separate.

views.label: feros-tunnels
views.note: Roofless distribution frames, low walls, pipes and valves distinguish the tunnels; the optional three-body varren pack is separate from the party.

views.label: feros-skyway
views.note: Perimeter rails and plunging structural supports identify the exposed elevated way; no altitude simulation was added.

views.label: feros-exogeni
views.note: Flanking industrial blocks and the research approach leave the party and encounter approach visible.

views.label: feros-thorian
views.note: Rooted perimeter and distant organic vault retain a roofless readable arena; the full original multi-floor lair remains open.

views.label: ilos-landing
views.note: Ancient pillars, vegetation and a static Mako mark the landing sector. Only Therum has the drivable Mako.

views.label: ilos-gardens
views.note: The party and distant geth contact are separate within the garden route.

views.label: ilos-archives
views.note: Peripheral galleries leave the three party bodies and locked passage contact visible.

views.label: ilos-cryogenic
views.note: Cryostasis cylinders and ancient pillars flank the open tactical approach.

views.label: ilos-conduit
views.note: Vigil and the framed Conduit are visible from the native party approach without a foreground roof.

views.label: fleet-normandy-sr1
views.note: The SR1 is an explicitly blue recognition projection with local projector/caption; the two passive Gasbags remain separate.

views.label: fleet-geth-dropship
views.note: The transport is a blue local projection; its small caption meets existing sector signage, while hull, projector and party remain visible.

views.label: fleet-destiny-ascension
views.note: Both known Citadel vessels are local recognition projections, with captions and bases, rather than miniature physical ships above the Presidium.

views.label: fleet-sovereign
views.note: Sovereign is a discreet blue local recognition projection, separate from the three visible combat contacts and the party. Full illustration is in the Codex.

views.label: fleet-michel-contact
views.note: Michel, party and conversation approach remain visible beside the two recognition projections.

views.label: heavy-feros
views.note: The Armature has a separate body envelope from the two ordinary geth and all three party bodies.

views.label: heavy-virmire
views.note: The Colossus and Krogan retain separate body envelopes; no camera-facing building covers either formation.

limitations: Original contours, distances, interiors, skyline scales and level transitions are not reconstructed 1:1. These remain authored prototype maps.
The snapshots use legal setPosition viewpoints, native campaign factories and settled native camera transforms. They are static inspection, not public traversal or FPS measurement.
The complete raw native artwork and detailed vessel/fauna views are assessed separately by their owning agents.
The tiny transport caption meets existing sector signage at the Therum spawn; the full ship dossier remains accessible in the Codex.
corrections: Moved camera-facing Feros colony blocks away from the party/contact square.
Added visible roofless tunnel frames and skyway rails/supports.
Separated inspection approaches from encounter POI centers.
Converted physical-looking peripheral vessel miniatures into explicitly labelled blue recognition projections.
Moved transport and Sovereign projectors away from scenery and guard bodies.
Prevented menu transitions from reviving retired Feros contact markers.
